scripts.build: concurrently -n client,server,lean -c green,blue,yellow "npm run build:client" "npm run build:server" "npm run build:lean"
scripts.start: concurrently -n client,server -c green,blue "npm run start:client" "npm run start:server"
scripts.test: npm run test:lean && npm run test:client
scripts.test:client: npm run test:build-game && concurrently -n app,cypress -c blue,green "npm start" "cypress run" -k -s first --hide app
scripts.test:build-game: cd GameSkeleton && rm -f lake-manifest.json && lake update -R -Kleangame.testgame --keep-toolchain && lake build && lake build GameServer
scripts.test:prod: npm run build && npm run test:build-game && concurrently -n app,cypress -c blue,green "node server/dist/index.js" "cypress run --config baseUrl=http://localhost:8000" -k -s first --hide app
scripts.test:ui: concurrently -n app,cypress -c blue,green "npm start" "cypress open" -k -s first --hide app
scripts.api:check: cmp server/src/api.ts client/src/api.ts && echo "api.ts is identical on both sides"
